buyer_id.description: Reference to a Buyer record. Null until a Buyer is created from the submission. Nullable.

company_name.description: Company name captured on the submission before a Buyer exists.

form_payload.description: JSON object holding the complete raw submission, including free text answers not promoted to Buyer fields, such as prior lead generation experience, that experience described, and additional requirements. Always the current version; every prior version is archived immutably in submission_history before being replaced.

submission_version.description: Version number of the current form_payload. Starts at 1 and increments by one every time a resubmission through the same onboarding link replaces the prior payload.

submission_history.description: JSON array of prior submission snapshots, each {version, form_payload, submitted_at}, archived immutably before the next resubmission overwrites form_payload. A resubmission never destroys the prior submission's content. Empty or absent until a second submission occurs.

steps.description: JSON array of step objects. Each step has key, status (pending, running, complete, failed, skipped), attempts, error, external_id and completed_at. The external_id records what was already created on the remote system so a retry is safe.

current_step.description: Key of the step currently being processed. Nullable.

intro_email_scheduled_for.description: When the intro email is scheduled to send. Nullable.

submitted_at.description: When the submission was received. Nullable.
